title: subspecies — query

sentences.sentence: Several other subspecies of gull are found in the region.
sentences.translation: 几个海鸥的其他亚种在此地区被找到。

sentences.sentence: a rug made out of old scraps of material
sentences.translation: 用旧零碎材料拼做的一块小地毯

sentences.translation: 市中心热闹的新年庆祝活动

sentences.translation: 薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。

sentences.sentence: He vanished into the mist.
sentences.translation: 他消失在雾中。

sentences.sentence: The hills were shrouded in mist (= covered in mist, so that you could not see them ) .
sentences.translation: 山峦笼罩在雾霭之中。

sentences.sentence: The mist came down off the mountains.
sentences.translation: 雾从山上飘下来。

sentences.sentence: The mists rolled in off the sea (= came on to the land from the sea ) .
sentences.translation: 雾气从海上涌来。

sentences.sentence: the look of joy on her face
sentences.translation: 她脸上的喜悦表情

sentences.sentence: a boat propelled by a small motor
sentences.translation: 由小马达驱动的小船

sentences.sentence: One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
sentences.translation: 我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

phrases.translation: 有判断力[通常用于否定句]

sentences.translation: 一盒彩色粉笔

sentences.translation: 一支粉笔

sentences.sentence: writing in chalk on the blackboard
sentences.translation: 黑板上的粉笔字

sentences.translation: 该系统可以支持无限多的用户。

sentences.sentence: unlimited access to information
sentences.translation: 无限制查阅资料

sentences.sentence: The ticket offers unlimited travel on the London underground for seven days.
sentences.translation: 凭本票可在七日内无限次乘坐伦敦地铁。

sentences.sentence: Upon receipt of a copy of the arbitration application, the respondent shall, within the time limit prescribed by the Arbitration Rules, submit its defence to the arbitration commission.
sentences.translation: 被申请人收到仲裁申请书副本后，应当在仲裁规则规定的期限内向仲裁委员会提交答辩书。

sentences.sentence: ...a moving portrayal of St. John the Evangelist by Simone Martini.
sentences.translation: …西蒙纳·马蒂尼创作的福音传道者圣约翰的感人画像。

sentences.sentence: A state of emergency has been declared.
sentences.translation: 已宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.sentence: Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
sentences.translation: 斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。

sentences.sentence: We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
sentences.translation: 我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

sentences.translation: 红色的丝绒窗帘

sentences.translation: 他将螺钉与他前臂的一个小六边形纹身比了比，尺寸是一样的。

sentences.translation: 诗歌的表达方式

sentences.translation: 我终于可以安安静静地工作了。

sentences.sentence: Staff are always available to answer your queries.
sentences.translation: 员工随时为您解答疑问。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 237 单元

subspecies
音标：英 /'sʌbspiːʃiːz; -ʃɪz; -spiːs-/  美 /sʌb'spiʃiz/
n. [生]亚种
例句：Several other subspecies of gull are found in the region.
几个海鸥的其他亚种在此地区被找到。

scrap
音标：英 /skræp/  美 /skræp/
n. 碎片
v. 废弃
短语：scrap metal — 废金属
短语：steel scrap — 钢屑，废钢料
短语：scrap iron — n. 铁屑；废铁
短语：a scrap of paper — n. 碎纸片
短语：scrap steel — 废钢
短语：metal scrap — 及废五金；废金属
短语：scrap material — [经]废料
短语：scrap rate — 切屑量；废金属比
短语：copper scrap — n. 废铜；红铜杂件
短语：not a scrap — 一点也没有
短语：scrap paper — 废纸；便条纸
短语：iron scrap — 废铁，屑铁
短语：scrap heap — 废料堆
短语：scrap rubber — 废橡皮；废橡胶
短语：aluminium scrap — 废铝
例句：a rug made out of old scraps of material
用旧零碎材料拼做的一块小地毯

celebration
音标：英 /selɪ'breɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,sɛlɪ'breʃən/
n. 庆祝, 庆典
短语：in celebration of — 为庆祝…
例句：the lively New Year celebrations in the city centre
市中心热闹的新年庆祝活动

mist
音标：英 /mɪst/  美 /mɪst/
n. 薄雾
短语：water mist — 水雾
短语：oil mist — [化]油雾
短语：through the mist — 透过迷雾
短语：acid mist — 酸雾
短语：mist eliminator — 除雾器；捕沫器
短语：salt mist — 盐雾
例句：We could just see the outline of the house through the mist.
薄雾中我们只能看到房子的轮廓。
例句：He vanished into the mist.
他消失在雾中。
例句：The hills were shrouded in mist (= covered in mist, so that you could not see them ) .
山峦笼罩在雾霭之中。
例句：The mist came down off the mountains.
雾从山上飘下来。
例句：The mists rolled in off the sea (= came on to the land from the sea ) .
雾气从海上涌来。

joy
音标：英 /dʒɒɪ/  美 /dʒɔɪ/
n. 欢乐, 喜悦
短语：with joy — 高兴地
短语：tears of joy — 高兴的泪水，喜极而泣
例句：the look of joy on her face
她脸上的喜悦表情

propel
音标：英 /prə'pel/  美 /prə'pɛl/
v. 推进, 驱使
例句：a boat propelled by a small motor
由小马达驱动的小船
例句：One of our students was unable to propel her wheelchair up the ramp.
我们有名学生无法把她的轮椅推上坡道。

chalk
音标：英 /tʃɔːk/  美 /tʃɔk/
n. 粉笔
短语：chalk it up — v. 记帐；宣布
短语：french chalk — n. 滑石粉
短语：chalk up — 记下；取得；归咎于
短语：a piece of chalk — 一支粉笔
短语：know chalk from cheese — 有判断力[通常用于否定句]
短语：white chalk — 白粉笔
例句：a box of coloured chalks
一盒彩色粉笔
例句：a piece of chalk
一支粉笔
例句：writing in chalk on the blackboard
黑板上的粉笔字

weaver
音标：英 /'wiːvə/  美 /'wivɚ/
n. 织布者

dropstone
n. 滴石

unlimited
音标：英 /ʌn'lɪmɪtɪd/  美 /ʌn'lɪmɪtɪd/
adj. 无限的；过渡的
短语：unlimited liability — 无限责任
例句：The system can support an unlimited number of users.
该系统可以支持无限多的用户。
例句：unlimited access to information
无限制查阅资料
例句：The ticket offers unlimited travel on the London underground for seven days.
凭本票可在七日内无限次乘坐伦敦地铁。

respondent
音标：英 /rɪ'spɒnd(ə)nt/  美 /rɪ'spɑndənt/
n. 应答者, 被告
例句：Upon receipt of a copy of the arbitration application, the respondent shall, within the time limit prescribed by the Arbitration Rules, submit its defence to the arbitration commission.
被申请人收到仲裁申请书副本后，应当在仲裁规则规定的期限内向仲裁委员会提交答辩书。

portrayal
音标：英 /pɔː'treɪəl/  美 /pɔr'treəl/
n. 描画, 描写
例句：...a moving portrayal of St. John the Evangelist by Simone Martini.
…西蒙纳·马蒂尼创作的福音传道者圣约翰的感人画像。

declare
音标：英 /dɪ'kleə/  美 /dɪ'klɛr/
v. 宣布，声明
短语：declare oneself — 显露身分；发表意见
短语：declare for — v. 表明赞成（拥护）
短语：nothing to declare — 绿色通道；不需报关
短语：declare bankruptcy — 宣告破产
短语：declare war on — v. 发动进攻；对…宣战
短语：declare on — 宣布
例句：A state of emergency has been declared.
已宣布进入紧急状态。
例句：Mr Steel has been declared bankrupt
斯蒂尔先生被宣布破产了。
例句：We celebrate September 16, the day when Mexico declared independence from Spain (= officially stated that it was no longer ruled by Spain ) .
我们在9月16日举行庆祝活动，这一天是墨西哥摆脱西班牙统治宣布独立的日子。

curtain
音标：英 /'kɜːt(ə)n/  美 /'kɝtn/
n. 窗帘
短语：curtain wall — 幕墙；护墙
短语：glass curtain wall — 玻璃幕墙
短语：behind the curtain — adv. 幕后；秘密
短语：water curtain — 水幕
短语：curtain grouting — 帷幕灌浆
短语：air curtain — 空气帘，气幕
短语：curtain call — 演员谢幕
短语：shower curtain — 浴帘；浴盆帘
短语：bamboo curtain — 竹幕（西方资产阶级舆论界过去对我国的诬蔑性用语）
短语：iron curtain — 铁幕；（阻隔消息，思想交流的）无形屏障
短语：window curtain — n. 窗帘
短语：curtain of night — 夜幕
短语：ring down the curtain — v. 落幕；结束
短语：curtain material — 窗帘材料
短语：door curtain — 门帘
短语：curtain rod — 窗帘杆，	挂帘杆；幕杆
短语：grout curtain — 水泥屏障；薄浆隔墙；灌浆帷幕
短语：curtain coating — 帘膜式淋涂
短语：net curtain — 网眼帘
短语：curtain track — 窗帘滑轨
例句：red velvet curtains
红色的丝绒窗帘

hexagon
音标：英 /'heksəg(ə)n/  美 /'hɛksəɡɑn/
n. 六角形, 六边形
短语：hexagon head — 六角头
短语：hexagon bolt — n. 六角形螺栓
例句：He presses the bolt against a small hexagon tattooed on his forearm. The sizes match.
他将螺钉与他前臂的一个小六边形纹身比了比，尺寸是一样的。

poetic
音标：英 /pəʊ'etɪk/  美 /po'ɛtɪk/
adj. 诗歌的
例句：poetic expression
诗歌的表达方式

undisturbed
音标：英 /ʌndɪ'stɜːbd/  美 /,ʌndɪ'stɝbd/
adj. 未受干扰的
短语：undisturbed soil — 原状土；原壮土；未扰动土
例句：At last I was able to work undisturbed.
我终于可以安安静静地工作了。

ascent
音标：英 /ə'sent/  美 /ə'sɛnt/
n. 上升,提高
例句：the first ascent of Qomolangma
首次攀登珠穆朗玛峰

Talbot
n. [动]塔尔博特提猎狗
例句：The photograph was taken by William Henry Fox Talbot, the inventor of the negative / positive photographic process.
这张照片是由威廉·亨利·福克斯·塔尔博特摄制，他是负片/正片摄影过程的发明者。

query
音标：英 /'kwɪərɪ/  美 /'kwɪri/
n&v. 质问,疑问
短语：query language — 查询语言
短语：query builder — 查询生成器
短语：structured query language — 结构化查询语言
短语：query the database — 查询数据库
例句：Staff are always available to answer your queries.
员工随时为您解答疑问。
